summary: This React component displays a collapsible list of blog posts that belong to the same series. It fetches all blog posts, filters them to only those matching the given series name, sorts them by date, and then renders each one as either a link or plain text depending on whether it's the current post being read.

explanations.45: useBlogMetadata() returns all available blog posts; then we chain .filter() to keep only posts whose series property matches the series prop passed in, and .sort() to arrange them chronologically from oldest to newest.
explanations.51: useSeriesLocalizer() returns a function that translates series names based on the user's current language; the ?? series part means 'use the English series name as a fallback if no translation exists'.
explanations.59: Translate is a Docusaurus component that handles multi-language support; the id uniquely identifies this string for translation, and values lets us inject the seriesLink as a variable into the template text.
explanations.73: We check if this particular post's permalink matches the excludePermalink prop, which tells us whether this is the current article being viewed.
explanations.79: clsx combines multiple CSS class names together, conditionally including currentPostDimmed only if highlightCurrent is true; this lets us visually emphasize the current post.
